name: setu
title: Setu
description: Manage git worktrees, dev servers, and ports across your projects
author: mukulchugh

commands.name: list-worktrees
commands.title: List Worktrees
commands.subtitle: Setu
commands.description: See every registered worktree, its status, and act on it

commands.name: create-worktree
commands.title: Create Worktree
commands.subtitle: Setu
commands.description: Check out a new branch as a worktree

commands.name: quick-open
commands.title: Quick Open Worktree
commands.subtitle: Setu
commands.description: Jump straight to a worktree's local domain

tools.name: list-worktrees
tools.title: List Worktrees
tools.description: Lists every registered Setu worktree with its status (running/stopped/queued), dirty file count, and ahead/behind counts.

tools.name: start-worktree
tools.title: Start Worktree
tools.description: Starts a worktree's dev server, in whichever mode (bare or container) it's currently sticky to.

tools.name: stop-worktree
tools.title: Stop Worktree
tools.description: Stops a worktree's running dev server.

tools.name: sync-worktree
tools.title: Sync Worktree with Staging
tools.description: Merges a worktree's resolved base branch (staging, or the project's default) into it. Only completes if the merge is clean; aborts automatically on conflict.

ai.instructions: Worktree names are unique per repo, not globally — if a name could belong to more than one registered project, ask which repo before acting.

preferences.name: portalUrl
preferences.title: Setu portal URL
preferences.description: Where the Setu portal is running — change this only if you've moved PORTAL_PORT in lib.js.
